policies.inbound:
* POSTOPTIONS *
<set-variable name="mcpBody" value="@(context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" /> <set-variable name="mcpMethod" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpBody")?["method"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty)" /> <set-variable name="mcpId" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpBody")?["id"]?.ToString() ?? "1")" />

backend.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpMethod") == "initialize")">
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          @{
            var id = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpId");
            return
              "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":" + id + "," +
              "\"result\":{" +
                "\"protocolVersion\":\"2024-11-05\"," +
                "\"capabilities\":{\"tools\":{}}," +
                "\"serverInfo\":{\"name\":\"apim-mcp-gateway\",\"version\":\"1.0.0\"}" +
              "}}";
          }
        
      

      
      <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpMethod") == "tools/list")">
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          
          @{
            var id = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpId");
            var tools =
              "[" +
                "{" +
                  "\"name\":\"uom_conversion\"," +
                  "\"description\":\"Convert a unit of measure for a product item in the ERP system. Returns the base UOM and conversion factor.\"," +
                  "\"inputSchema\":{" +
                    "\"type\":\"object\"," +
                    "\"properties\":{" +
                      "\"itemNumber\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Product item number\"}," +
                      "\"orgCode\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Organization code e.g. MAS\"}" +
                    "}," +
                    "\"required\":[\"itemNumber\",\"orgCode\"]" +
                  "}" +
                "}," +
                "{" +
                  "\"name\":\"update_order_request\"," +
                  "\"description\":\"Update a Dimitri AOP rework order with new reason code, date, and appointment type.\"," +
                  "\"inputSchema\":{" +
                    "\"type\":\"object\"," +
                    "\"properties\":{" +
                      "\"SO_NUMBER\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Sales order number\"}," +
                      "\"REASON_CODE\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Reason code e.g. 02-Customer-CPU Carrier\"}," +
                      "\"REQUEST_DATE\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"New date in ISO 8601 format\"}," +
                      "\"APPOINTMENT_TYPE\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"description\":\"Appointment type code e.g. NP\"}" +
                    "}," +
                    "\"required\":[\"SO_NUMBER\",\"REASON_CODE\",\"REQUEST_DATE\",\"APPOINTMENT_TYPE\"]" +
                  "}" +
                "}" +
              "]";
            return
              "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":" + id + "," +
              "\"result\":{\"tools\":" + tools + "}}";
          }
        
      

      
      <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpMethod") == "tools/call")">
        <set-variable name="toolName"
          value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpBody")?["params"]?["name"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty)" />
        <set-variable name="toolArgs"
          value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpBody")?["params"]?["arguments"])" />

        

          
          <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolName") == "uom_conversion")">
            <set-variable name="itemNumber"
              value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolArgs")?["itemNumber"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty)" />
            <set-variable name="orgCode"
              value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolArgs")?["orgCode"]?.ToString() ?? string.Empty)" />
            
              @($"https://apim-dev-intg.azure-api.net/api/dev/uom/v1/uomConversion?itemNumber={Uri.EscapeDataString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("itemNumber"))}&orgCode={Uri.EscapeDataString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("orgCode"))}")
              GET
              
                {{apim-uom-dev-key}}
              
            
            
              
              
                application/json
              
              @{
                var id = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpId");
                var body = ((IResponse)context.Variables["backendResp"]).Body.As();
                var escaped = body.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("\"", "\\\"").Replace("\n", "\\n").Replace("\r", "");
                return
                  "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":" + id + "," +
                  "\"result\":{\"content\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"" + escaped + "\"}],\"isError\":false}}";
              }
            
          

          
          <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolName") == "update_order_request")">
            
              https://apim-uat-intg.azure-api.net/uat/api/dimitri/v1/updateOrderRequest
              POST
              
                application/json
              
              
                {{apim-dimitri-uat-key}}
              
              @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolArgs")?.ToString() ?? "{}")
            
            
              
              
                application/json
              
              @{
                var id = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpId");
                var body = ((IResponse)context.Variables["backendResp"]).Body.As();
                var escaped = body.Replace("\\", "\\\\").Replace("\"", "\\\"").Replace("\n", "\\n").Replace("\r", "");
                return
                  "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":" + id + "," +
                  "\"result\":{\"content\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"" + escaped + "\"}],\"isError\":false}}";
              }
            
          

          
          
            
              
              
                application/json
              
              @{
                var id = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpId");
                var tool = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolName");
                return
                  "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":" + id + "," +
                  "\"error\":{\"code\":-32602,\"message\":\"Unknown tool: " + tool + "\"}}";
              }
            
          
        
      

      
      
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          @{
            var id = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("mcpId");
            return
              "{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":" + id + "," +
              "\"error\":{\"code\":-32601,\"message\":\"Method not found\"}}";
          }
